name: Mara Venn
description: Woke on a white bench with somewhere to go and no way to name it. The steadiest of the three, and she only starts thinking clearly once the road stops being safe.

name: Ila
description: The smith's apprentice. Carried the sword all the way to a door that finally opened. Her strikes leave an opening the others can follow.

name: Bram
description: The gate keeper of the Dragon Tomb. While both of his numbers are 1 the gate is shut, and the first blow of the turn is turned aside.

name: Sable
description: A copyist from the Blank Archive. She brings an Ink Echo into the fight; when it falls she spends two turns writing it back.
